purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Benue’s official BENGIS and Ministry of Lands and Survey evidence local/state cadastral and land-record custody for Gboko, but no anonymous safe parcel-ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: BENGIS describes itself as the official geospatial-data custodian and describes digital cadastral/topographic maps and land-records management. The Benue State Ministry describes land-document registration and survey-related services. These are relevant state/local custodians, not proof of open citywide parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official BENGIS site identifies the Benue Geographic Information System as a Benue State Government geospatial and land-services agency and references Gboko in its service material.
Official BENGIS scope describes digital cadastral/topographic maps, geodatabase work, and digitization/management of historical land records.

Official Benue State Ministry of Lands and Survey site describes title-document processing and registration of Certificates of Occupancy, Deeds of Assignment, Powers of Attorney and Letters of Administration.
